from scipy.optimize import least_squares
e=np.asarray(df['eps'],dtype=float); t=np.asarray(df['T'],dtype=float); s=np.asarray(df['sigma'],dtype=float)
A=lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[0]*np.sqrt(t))
mods={
 'M2_eps_expT': lambda p: A(p) + p[1]*e*np.exp(-p[2]*e)/t + p[3]*e*np.exp(-p[4]/t),
 'M3_expT_eps': lambda p: A(p) + p[1]*e*np.exp(-p[2]*e)/t + p[3]*np.exp(-p[4]/t)*np.exp(-p[5]*e),
 'M4_free_a': lambda p: p[6]*np.exp(-p[0]*np.sqrt(t)) + p[1]*e*np.exp(-p[2]*e)/t + p[3]*np.exp(-p[4]/t),
 'M5_sqrt_eps': lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[0]*np.sqrt(t)) + p[1]*np.sqrt(e)*np.exp(-p[2]*e)/t + p[3]*np.exp(-p[4]/t),
}
rs=np.random.RandomState(1)
for k,m in mods.items():
    best=None
    for it in range(40):
        p0=rs.uniform(0.1,3,7)
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: np.nan_to_num(m(p)-s,nan=1e3,posinf=1e3,neginf=-1e3), p0)
            if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
        except Exception: pass
    print(k, np.var(s-m(best.x))/np.var(s), np.round(best.x,4))
